ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The top side of the large rectangle ABCD is AB, and the right side is BC. In the figure, the large rectangle is divided into upper and lower layers by a horizontal line; the upper layer has 4 congruent small rectangles placed vertically and arranged side by side, and the lower layer has 3 congruent small rectangles placed horizontally and arranged side by side. Reasoning: Let the short side of each small rectangle be s and the long side be l. The 4 vertically placed small rectangles in the upper layer are joined horizontally to form AB, so AB = 4s. The 3 horizontally placed small rectangles in the lower layer are also joined horizontally to form the same width AB, so AB = 3l. Therefore 4s = 3l, giving l = 4s/3. The height BC of the large rectangle equals the height of the upper layer plus the height of the lower layer, that is, BC = l + s = 4s/3 + s = 7s/3. Thus AB/BC = 4s / (7s/3) = 12/7.

raw_record.question_text: The big rectangle $ABCD$ is made up of 7 congruent smaller rectangles (see diagram). What is the ratio $\frac{AB}{BC}$?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a large rectangle ABCD with AB as the top side and BC as the right side. The image shows 4 congruent small rectangles arranged across the top row in one orientation, and 3 congruent small rectangles arranged across the bottom row rotated 90 degrees. Let the smaller rectangle have short side s and long side l. From the top row, the large width is AB = 4s. From the bottom row, the same large width is AB = 3l, so 4s = 3l and l = 4s/3. The large height is BC = l + s because it consists of the height of the top row plus the height of the bottom row. Thus BC = 4s/3 + s = 7s/3. Therefore AB/BC = 4s / (7s/3) = 12/7.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: AB is divided by the top row into 4 equal widths, while the same full width is divided by the bottom row into 3 equal widths. Let the full width AB be W. Then each top rectangle has width W/4, and each bottom rectangle has width W/3. Since the 7 rectangles are congruent but the bottom ones are rotated compared with the top ones, the height of a top rectangle must equal the width of a bottom rectangle, W/3, and the height of a bottom rectangle must equal the width of a top rectangle, W/4. Therefore the total height is BC = W/3 + W/4 = 7W/12. Hence AB/BC = W / (7W/12) = 12/7.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中大矩形 ABCD 的上边为 AB，右边为 BC。大矩形被一条水平线分成上下两排；上排可见 4 个等宽的小矩形并排排列，下排可见 3 个等宽的小矩形并排排列。题目说明这 7 个小矩形全都全等，因此上下两排的小矩形方向相差 90 度。推理：设大矩形宽 AB = W。上排 4 个小矩形平分全宽，所以每个上排小矩形的宽是 W/4。下排 3 个小矩形平分全宽，所以每个下排小矩形的宽是 W/3。由于上下小矩形全等且旋转放置，上排小矩形的高等于下排小矩形的宽，即 W/3；下排小矩形的高等于上排小矩形的宽，即 W/4。因此 BC = W/3 + W/4 = 7W/12。于是 AB/BC = W/(7W/12) = 12/7。
